The reviewer confirmed no defects, and the manual CLI test I ran earlier already exercised the end-to-end path it couldn't test.

Added a `--json` flag to `habit list`: `src/commands.js`'s `list()` now takes an options object and, when `{ json: true }`, returns `JSON.stringify([{name, streak}, ...])`; `src/cli.js` parses `--json` off argv and passes it through. Tests added for both the populated and empty-list JSON cases; all 9 tests pass and a manual run confirms `node src/cli.js list --json` outputs valid JSON.

One decision baked in: the JSON schema is `{name, streak}` per habit (matching what the text view already shows) rather than the full `done` date array — happy to add `done` too if you want the raw history in the JSON output.
